assertions.assertion: The claim is for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring
The CPT code for the service is 93229
The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to assess for ischemic changes
SilverBridge Advantage requires precertification for non-emergency diagnostic monitoring services
The appeal submits the clinical indication to establish medical necessity
The appeal submits the clinical indication to establish coverage eligibility
